## In-class assessments

1. The "Before class" preparatory readings and chapters of this book, listed below, are the essential readings. Ensure you can correctly answer the "Test yourself" quizzes in the book.
2. Preparatory readings are to be done before the session they're associated with, as they enable you to understand the slides. 
3. In-class assessments occur on later weeks. 

So, for example, if we discuss misinterpretations of *p*-values in week 3, you should a) read and understand the "Before class" readings before class and be able to complete the quizzes in the book; and b) this content may be assessed in an in-class assignment from week 3 onward. The timing of the in-class assignments is not disclosed ahead of time - their point is to ensure that you do the readings.
